title: Implement single-Photo processing orchestration

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Photo orchestration tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_photo_orchestration.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification on the exact current image passed mypy, the four-case UUID PostgreSQL/MinIO orchestration probe and Memory Bank lint. Both exact-revision ready paths, no_faces, deterministic derivatives, terminal publication and owner-bounded failure routing passed; architecture inspection found no duplicated policy, loop, scheduler, retry selector, durable orchestration state or foreign write. Cleanup left zero task rows/objects/active processing/one-off residue and restored the idle runtime baseline. Executor receipts remained supporting-only.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-processing.md#single-photo-orchestration RED: no owner-local operation composes claimed original, exact revision adapter, derivatives and terminal/failure boundaries; GREEN: deterministic SFace, Buffalo M, zero-face and injected-failure cases each call only their accepted boundaries and reach one matching outcome without new state; decisive comparison: call trace, selected revision, terminal path and foreign-write scan match the contract; artifact: focused orchestration integration output.
purpose: Compose the completed claim, adapter, derivative and terminal boundaries for one claimed Photo without owning their policies.
success_outcome: One claimed Photo loads its immutable original and exact validated adapter, then reaches the matching ready, no_faces or bounded failure boundary without a second lifecycle.
anti_goals: Do not add a worker loop, scheduler, retry policy, model selector, realtime query or direct foreign write.
Do not duplicate adapter, derivative or terminal-publication rules in orchestration.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: Orchestration would need business logic in the entrypoint/infrastructure or direct foreign repository writes.
A generic workflow/scheduler abstraction becomes necessary to run one Photo.

constraints: Keep orchestration under processing and call only accepted owner-local or published projection boundaries.
Select the adapter only from the claimed immutable pipeline_revision_id.
Tests use fake native results only to compose already implemented production boundaries.
invariants: One claim runs one exact adapter and one terminal outcome path.
No model auto-selection, cross-engine intermediate reuse or foreign write occurs.
Orchestration adds no durable state of its own.
verification_targets: Integration proof composes SFace face, Buffalo M face, zero-face and injected failure cases through owner boundaries and traces absence of handler/entrypoint business orchestration.
